title: WONDERFUL, WONDERFUL JESUS
author: Anna B.Russell
stanzas: There is never a day so dreary, There is never a night so long, But the soul that is trusting in Jesus will somewhere find a song
There is never a cross so heavy, There is never a weight of woe, But that Jesus will help to carry because He loveth so.
There is never a care or burden, There is never a grief or loss, But that Jesus in love will lighten When carried to the cross
There is never a guilty sinner, There is never a wandering one, But that God can in mercy pardon through Jesus Christ, His son.
chorus: wonderful, wonferful Jesus. In the heart He implanteth a song: A song of deliverance, of courage, of strength. In the heart he imlanteth a song
